# NoPostNow

> A private photo feed for you and your friends, running on a computer you own. Next.js, one SQLite file, no outside services. MIT licensed.

## Set up

1. `git clone https://github.com/jthy10/nopostnow.git` (or download https://github.com/jthy10/nopostnow/archive/refs/heads/main.zip)
2. In that folder: `sh nopostnow.sh` (Windows: `.\nopostnow.cmd`). It fetches Node.js if missing.
3. Answer the setup questions, then sign in at http://localhost:3000.
4. To invite friends, give it a public https address: https://github.com/jthy10/nopostnow/blob/main/docs/GOING-ONLINE.md

## Commands

On Windows, use `.\nopostnow.cmd` in place of `sh nopostnow.sh`.

- Start: `sh nopostnow.sh`
- Start without the panel: `sh nopostnow.sh start`
- Change settings: `sh nopostnow.sh setup`
- List accounts: `sh nopostnow.sh users list`
- Make an invite link: `sh nopostnow.sh users invite`
- Reset a password: `sh nopostnow.sh users reset their@email`
- Make someone an admin: `sh nopostnow.sh users admin their@email`
- Update: `git pull`, then start again

## Data

Everything is in the data folder (`data/` by default): `nopostnow.db` (posts, accounts, messages), `files/` (photos), `config.json` (settings). Back up or move by copying that folder.
